title: Premise, Arc, Phase, Chapter & Open-World Structure
objective: Extend the MAS Adventure-authoring workspace with deterministic structural representations for premise, arc, phase, chapter and open-world organization while preserving MAS-01 authority boundaries and supporting linear, branching, sandbox and hybrid Adventure structures without treating prepared structure as live runtime state.

scope.purpose: Represent Adventure premise and higher-order structural organization inside the MAS workspace without forcing a single story shape or taking canonical Story/Adventure/runtime authority.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS Adventure workspace can deterministically express premise, arcs, phases, chapters and open-world structural groupings, including non-linear/sandbox forms, while remaining prepared authoring structure rather than live runtime truth and without duplicating canonical Story/Adventure/CNI owner authority.

selection_boundaries: MAS-01 remains the Adventure Studio workspace/document and authority foundation; MAS-02 composes through its explicit workspace reference without reopening it.
Existing MAS validation family remained active; no family transition occurred in MAS-02.
Linear, branching, node-based, sandbox and hybrid structures are supported without a required golden path or mandatory linear hierarchy.
Prepared structural definitions remain distinct from live occurrences and canonical runtime state.
Parent and open-world membership references fail closed when unresolved; MAS-02 does not infer route, choice, consequence or runtime dependency semantics reserved for later tranches.
CSW remains pre-authoritative creative/storycraft workspace; CNI and canonical owner domains retain their existing runtime/state authorities.
ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after MAS-02; no new cross-program rotation is unlocked, so MAS-03 is selected_not_started.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-04+ and SMB-08 were not implemented by this tranche.
next_action: MAS-02 is closed. MAS-03 is selected_not_started after ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
